answer: Bonded, slowly vesting identity: every agent locks a refundable bond and its grading weight vests over many epochs, like an orchard that bears fruit only after seasons. A jury is drawn by verifiable randomness from bonded agents; if it proves an identity fake, the bond is slashed and paid to the accuser. This ferrous anchor of locked capital means an attacker running N fakes must lock N bonds, wait out vesting from each dawn, and risk losing every bond to one audit, so cost scales linearly while detection odds rise
